description: Machine-readable spec of a fictional 1990s serial weather station. The agent reads THIS file before sending any byte to the device; the spec is the contract, never a guess. Values, scaling and fault codes are invented for the demo device — the pattern (spec-as-contract + demo simulator + agent playbook) is what transfers to real legacy hardware.
name: WS-90 Legacy Weather Station

requests.!Ixxx: WRITE: set the live-stream interval (5..3600 s). Requires human confirmation.
requests.>L: Start the live stream (one frame per interval)
requests.?A: Read all parameters in one frame
requests.?I: Read the current live-stream interval in seconds
requests.?Pxx: Read one parameter by two-digit id, e.g. ?P01

safety: Always start in DEMO mode; never connect to real hardware before the demo session passes.
Read this spec before sending any byte; never guess a command.
Writes change device state: ask a human first, then pass --confirm.
Verify every frame checksum; a bad checksum means the line, not the device, is lying.
Log every session; a reading without a log did not happen.

transport.requests_start_with: ? for reads, ! for writes, > for stream control

SET_INTERVAL.effect: changes how often live frames are emitted
